onGotShield.reason: ShieldElement.Execute dispatches event 40 only when AliveProperty.shieldHitValueList (List<ShieldData> at +0x88, native List._size at +0x18) is empty; an already active shield instance skips the dispatch and only SetShield runs, so replacement or refresh of an existing shield does not re-dispatch event 40.

afterHeal.reason: OnExecuteDamageElement settles the heal before OnAfterHeal. OnAfterHeal forwards the executor as the event Target and contains no effective-delta gate, so an executed heal at full HP still dispatches while rejected descriptors do not.

sourceVisibility.reason: Self is evaluated against each native event subject: entered actor for SwitchEnter, shield recipient for OnGotShield, and heal source actor for AfterHeal.

sourceObserver.reason: GetTriggerTarget routes Source to ElementTriggerDataBase.source at +0x18. For AfterHeal this is the heal source actor, independently from the healed Target.

effectTarget.reason: InvokeTriggerElement_DamageHandle receives the healed executor as Target for AfterHeal; triggerEffectList.targetType=Target therefore resolves to that healed actor.

emptyConditionSemantics.reason: The native list loop reaches the empty-list branch; OR=1 and AND=0 both return true for zero conditions. Event 44 therefore does not require a synthetic condition.

block.reason: OnExecuteNormalElement routes combineType 5 to the active element scan. An incoming element with the same config is returned to ObjectPool without ExecuteElement or insertion; after the old instance leaves the active list a later instance follows the normal insertion path.
